title: Gao.Law - Intellectual Property Litigation & Case Updates
description: Latest landmark cases, articles, and updates from Gao.Law, a premier IP litigation practice in China specializing in patent infringement, trademark protection, and trade secret cases.

items.title: Boehringer v. DYG - First National Major Patent Infringement Case
items.summary: Represented Boehringer Ingelheim in the first and only National Major Patent Infringement Case in China. The judgment was successfully enforced across 28 provinces in just 18 months.
items.content_html:
Case: Boehringer v. DYG

Result: Landmark National Major Patent Infringement Case - the first and only in China

Achievement: Judgment successfully enforced against defendant across 28 provinces in only 18 months (filed 2023)

Practice Insight: Demonstrates Gao.Law's expertise in navigating China's highest-priority patent litigation framework and achieving rapid enforcement nationwide.

items.title: INEOS v. Sinopec - US$7 Billion Trade Secret Settlement
items.summary: One of the largest trade secret cases in Chinese history. Settlement collaboration resulted in US$7 billion of business for client over 10 years.
items.content_html:
Case: INEOS v. Sinopec

Type: One of the largest trade secret cases in Chinese history

Result: Strategic settlement resulting in US$7 billion of business for client over 10 years

Significance: One of the most successful settlements in China, demonstrating value of expert negotiation and strategy in complex trade secret disputes.

items.title: Michael Jordan v. Qiaodan - Supreme Court Landmark Victory
items.summary: 77 victories across 80+ cases filed nationwide. Supreme Court Model IP Case selected for International IP Day 2016. Strategic use of multi-jurisdiction filing to overcome local protection.
items.content_html:
Case: Michael Jordan v. Qiaodan Sports Co.

Claim: Protection of Chinese character mark "Qiaodan"

Result: 77 victories out of 80+ cases filed across China; Retrial petition successful at Chinese Supreme People's Court

Recognition: Selected as Supreme Court Model IP Case on International IP Day, April 26, 2016

Strategy: Novel approach using numerous coordinated filings to overcome long history of losses by previous counsel.

items.title: Apple v. Qualcomm - Largest SEP/FRAND Case in China
items.summary: Damages exceed RMB 1.6 billion. 30+ patent cases across 11 IP Courts and Supreme People's Court. Apple engaged only Dr. Gao's team while Qualcomm engaged 6 legal teams.
items.content_html:
Case: Apple v. Qualcomm

Type: Standard Essential Patent (SEP) licensing dispute - FRAND litigation

Scale: Damages claimed exceed RMB 1.6 billion; 30+ patent infringement cases

Scope: Litigation before 11 IP Courts, Provincial High Courts, and Supreme People's Court

Resources: Apple engaged only Dr. Gao's team; Qualcomm engaged 6 legal teams - demonstrating confidence in counsel choice

Status: Largest SEP case in China at the time.

items.title: Dow v. Luxi Chemical - US$102 Million Trade Secret Victory
items.summary: Won US$102 million in damages and injunction in breach of trade secret case. Demonstrates firm's expertise in protecting critical industrial secrets.
items.content_html:
Case: Dow v. Luxi Chemical

Claim: Breach of trade secret

Result: US$102 million in damages + injunction against defendant

Significance: Major victory protecting critical trade secrets in chemical/petrochemical industry.

items.title: Watson Pharma v. Eli Lilly - Supreme Court Reversal
items.summary: Supreme Court reversed RMB 151 million judgment against Watson. Selected as first Supreme Court Model IP Case on International IP Day 2014.
items.content_html:
Case: Watson Pharmaceutical v. Eli Lilly

Original Judgment: RMB 151 million against Watson Pharmaceutical

Appeal Result: Supreme People's Court reversed judgment in client's favor

Recognition: Selected as first Supreme Court Model IP Case on International IP Day, April 26, 2014

Context: Case was lost in lower proceedings before client engaged Gao.Law team for Supreme Court appeal.

items.title: Apple App Store - 140+ Copyright & Trademark Cases
items.summary: Represented Apple in 140+ copyright, trademark, and unfair competition disputes. Many selected as annual Top 10 IP Cases by NIPA and Beijing High Court.
items.content_html:
Case Portfolio: Apple App Store copyright and trademark enforcement

Scope: 140+ copyright infringement, trademark infringement, and unfair competition disputes

Recognition: Many cases selected as annual 'Top 10 IP Cases' by National Intellectual Property Administration (NIPA) and Beijing High Court
